comment: The only place a ledger finding may be accepted (docs/LEDGER.md). unexecutable: a locked check that can never pass at the edition's locked skills commit; each entry must match a live finding exactly (edition, check, rule) and FAILs once it no longer does. removals: a removed lock, locked check, layer carriage or provided function, with the owner ruling that allows it; an entry counts only in the change that adds it.

unexecutable.reason: swift.sign-in requires capability users.frontend-sign-in. surface-swift 1.19.2 provides that function, so the runner at 51fdaca establishes the capability only when every locked check of it passes; users.frontend-sign-in.persona-signs-in has no implemented binding (entry above), so the capability is never established and this check stays UNVERIFIED.

Only binding is planned at skills 51fdaca (snapshot 10.30.6 revision 2, dynamicweb/skills#245): a storefront sign-in is a POST of the persona's user name and password to /dwapi/users/authenticate and needs a sign-in handler and a persona credential supplied to the runner, which no handler has. surface-swift 1.19.2 provides users.frontend-sign-in (the sign-in page with the Users - Authentication app; its app-placed check is implemented). Stays UNVERIFIED on every host until a snapshot implements it.
